# Gelabber v0.14.0

A refinement release: new releases reach the installed apps and the
download links without a gap, the server overview fits small windows, and
"+" and "Entdecken" on the server rail look like the rest of the rail.
Behind the scenes, CI gets faster and releases shorter. **No database
migration and no `.env` change: going back to v0.13.1 only needs the older
image set.**

## Changes

**Servers and overview**

- The Übersicht fits a quarter-screen window, web and desktop: a one-line
  greeting with "Alles gelesen", a new "Im Call" card showing who sits in
  which voice channel with "Beitreten", flat Live cards with "Zuschauen",
  quiet busy channels as one line in "Verpasst", and fixed-size tiles in
  "Geteilt". #752 (GEL-75)
- Server rail: "Server hinzufügen" and "Entdecken" are tiles shaped like a
  server, below a separator line; "Entdecken" stays selected while the
  directory is open. #751 (GEL-74)
- Web: the channel list toggle no longer covers the "Freunde" and
  "Anfragen" titles, and stays hidden on phones. #761

**Desktop app and releases**

- A release becomes Latest only once both desktop apps are attached, so
  the update check and the download links no longer answer 404 while the
  desktop build runs. #747 (GEL-72)
- The Windows installer is tested the way the updater runs it (update,
  restart, uninstall); the Tauri 0.8 migration tests are gone. #747
  (GEL-72)
- A release signs and attaches the apps its release pull request already
  built, instead of building them again after the tag. #1036 (GEL-358)

**CI and repository**

- Backend tests build the password hashing and image crates optimized:
  a test shard now runs its tests in about 2 minutes instead of 6.5, and
  the test cache follows `Cargo.lock`. #1033 (GEL-355)
- CI on `main` reuses the release PR's result for the same files, and a
  push runs only the areas it changed. #1035, #1039, #1046 (GEL-357,
  GEL-360, GEL-363)
- Version branches merge through a merge queue, which tests each pull
  request on the branch's newest state. #1042, #1043, #1044 (GEL-362)
- Superseded Actions caches are deleted after each push. #1034 (GEL-356)
- zizmor checks the workflows; the release workflows no longer keep the
  token in `.git/config`, and the desktop release gets only its signing
  secrets. #1040 (GEL-361)
- Flaky tests fixed: storage cleanup, simulcast sizes and the provider
  sign-in clicks. #754, #756, #760 (GEL-76, GEL-77, GEL-78)
- The Claude Code hook that blocked pushes by branch name is gone. #1027
  (GEL-354)

## Upgrade notes

- **No migration, no new or changed `.env` variables.** A backup before
  the upgrade is still good practice (`deploy/backup.sh`, see
  `deploy/README.md` "Backup").
- The image pins `GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE` move together to
  `v0.14.0`. **Rollback:** the v0.13.1 image set.
- **Order:** server first, then clients. Older desktop apps keep working.
- **Desktop:** Windows offers the update itself; Arch: `pacman -Syu`.

All changes: [v0.13.1...v0.14.0](https://github.com/Till-und-Scholler-AI-slop/Gelabber/compare/v0.13.1...v0.14.0)
